frozen: 2026-10-04, before any GPU execution of the native energy-model update

recipe.source: examples/energy.py (s100l-rmlp-ebm-v1 equations, s100l-p1 BF16 product policy, s100l-rng-v1 counter layout, s100l-cd-v1 sampler, s100l-init-v1, s100l-fmnist-v1 data)

configs.tiny: crop 8, H32 F64 L2 B8 K3 R40
configs.small: crop 16, H64 F128 L2 B32 K4 R256
configs.wb: WB anchor: crop 28, H384 F768 L4 B256 K64 R10000 (2,665,728 parameters)
configs.sd: second config: crop 28, H384 F768 L8 B256 K32 R10000 (depth 8, chain 32; S108H SD)

recipe.derivative_boundaries: chain (init + K steps) uses pre-update parameters and only input gradients; the loss region differentiates parameters with negatives as constants (no derivative through sampling)
known_differences_from_s100l_programs: Langevin and fresh-row arithmetic are x + sigma*xi, y - lambda*G, (hi-lo)*u + lo with two FP32 roundings (generated code uses --fmad=false; PyTorch has no fma op); S100L used single-rounding FMA
AdamW bias corrections use the compiler's int64 step with -expm1(step*log(beta)); S100L used FP32 step counters and powf
reduction orders are the compiler's (deterministic) and differ from the S100L engines

references.R: c_ops4_b/reference.py: FP64, hand-derived input and parameter gradients (ported from S100L reference.py), independent NumPy Philox words, FP64 Box-Muller
references.C1: c_ops4_b/controls.py eager: PyTorch autograd, FP32 with the BF16 product policy, same GPU
references.C2: c_ops4_b/controls.py manual: eager with the S100L hand-written backward, FP32 with the BF16 product policy

same_state_rule.pass: e(native) <= max(2 * max(e(C1), e(C2)), 1e-6) for every observable
same_state_rule.chain_step_observable: increment x_k - x_{k-1} from the native's own x_{k-1} (native x_k obtained with runtime count k from the same pre-update state); steps 1..K when K <= 8, else {1,2,3,4,K/4,K/2,3K/4,K-1,K}
same_state_rule.update_observables: loss, raw gradients (all parameters), updated parameters, exp_avg, exp_avg_sq; R/C1/C2 evaluated from the native's own final negatives x_K and the pre-update state

exact_tiers: RNG words of philox_field equal the independent NumPy Philox (Random123 KAT included); uniforms exact; CPU normals within 1e-5 abs of the FP64 transform
native init x0 (runtime count 0) equals the reference replay rows / fresh draws bitwise
commit: new buffer equals the old buffer with rows (ptr + i) mod R replaced by the native x_K bitwise; ptr, t exact; key unchanged
repeat: two updates from the same state are bitwise equal (outputs and committed state)
one CUDA-graph replay of the update equals the raw launch bitwise
optimizer_tier: FP64 clip+AdamW recomputed from the native's own raw gradients: relative L2 error of the parameter change, exp_avg and exp_avg_sq <= 1e-5; every step counter advanced by one
trained_state: all gates repeated after the real-data training run (native trained state)

training.run: 400 updates on Fashion-MNIST (s100l-fmnist-v1 order) from the same init, RNG and data order for native, C1 eager and C2 manual
training.pass: all losses finite and d(native, C1) <= max(2 * d(C2, C1), 0.02), where d(a, b) = ||theta_a - theta_b|| / ||theta_C1 - theta_0|| after the run
training.report: loss trajectories, per-update relative loss deviation, held-out test and replay-buffer energies; no sample-quality or data-efficiency claim

performance.metric: complete update (init, K-step chain, positives, gradients, clip+AdamW, commit) median ms per update, CUDA events over CUDA-graph replays, paired randomized rounds (20), state restored before each round; ratio native / fastest valid conventional control with bootstrap 95% CI
performance.controls: eager, pieces_autotune (compiled chain/grads/optimizer, max-autotune-no-cudagraphs), fused_default and fused_autotune (whole update as one torch.compile(fullgraph) function, default / max-autotune-no-cudagraphs), each captured in one CUDA graph
performance.control_validity: a control is valid when its own update (from the same state) passes the same-state rule against R with C1/C2 calibration on loss, gradients, parameters and moments
performance.memory: native: arena + mutable bindings + shared data; controls: CUDA allocator peak delta during compile, capture and replay + shared data
performance.old_implementation: compared only on matching workloads (WB, SD); historical S103H/S108H timings are labelled historical and are not evidence for this code

tolerance_changes: none except the recorded, versioned amendments below; earlier verdicts are preserved, not relabelled

amendments.after: gpu-02 (first native gates; v1 verdicts preserved in its receipts)
amendments.scope: optimizer_tier only; every other gate unchanged
amendments.reason: v1 bounded the relative error of the FP32 parameter change against FP64 by 1e-5. A parameter stored in FP32 carries rounding ulp(w) ~ 4e-9 against an AdamW step of ~lr = 1e-4, i.e. ~4e-5 relative, for ANY FP32 implementation: the FP32 eager/manual controls measured 5.7e-5 (tiny) and 1.5e-5 (WB), equal to the native. m and v passed v1 (<= 8e-7).
amendments.rule: FP64 clip+AdamW from the native raw gradients is the reference; the FP32 control optimizer expression applied to the same raw gradients and pre-update state is the calibration. PASS iff steps advanced and, for the parameter change, exp_avg and exp_avg_sq, e(native) <= max(2 * e(FP32 control), 1e-6). Reports state both the v1 and the v1.1 verdicts.
